rules.statement: The SDC delivered with the IP (m_apb_tlul_bridge.sdc) must be the executable form of the timing tables, consistent with the clock, budget and exception tables.
No false path, multicycle path, min/max delay or clock group is used; all paths are single-cycle in a single synchronous domain.
Every changing APB4 and TL-UL output must be a flip-flop Q pin, with a timing budget of one cycle minus clock-to-output.
The integrator should place the APB pins and the TL-UL pins on the side of their respective buses.

rules.condition: channel-A load enable fans out to about 66 flip-flops
rules.statement: The integrator may buffer or duplicate the channel-A load enable.
